name: How should a homeowner prepare before door casing installation begins?

mainEntity.name: How should a homeowner prepare before door casing installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your trim carpenter arrives, you should determine your desired trim style and confirm whether you are keeping or replacing adjacent baseboards. Clear furniture, wall hangings, and rugs at least four to five feet around each doorway to provide ample room for step ladders, miter saws, and nail guns. If you are matching existing casing in an older Denver home, taking a small sample or measuring the exact profile width and thickness beforehand helps ensure your contractor sources matching stock.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the workspace around every doorway, confirm your trim profile and paint plans, and provide a sample or measurements if you need to match existing historical or custom molding.
